coverage_floors.basis: Ratchet against 52.90 percent combined measured on 2026-08-17 when branch measurement was enabled (57.95 percent line-only at that moment); the earlier line-only floor of 54 was ratcheted against roughly 55 percent measured in the first CI run, and the generator shipped 100, which had never passed. Same suite, stricter metric, not a regression. Raise it when real tests land; never lower it to make a red build green.

suites.framework: pytest with anyio; no pytest-asyncio. Database work runs against a mocked async session and httpx AsyncClient over ASGITransport, so the suite needs no live services.
suites.notes: Coverage is a ratcheted floor, so line coverage carries little signal. Invariant coverage below is the risk metric that matters here.

Self-skips when no database is reachable, by probing `alembic current`. CI runs it against the compose-pinned pgvector image; a plain postgres image passes everything up to revision 0026 and then fails.

suites.framework: pytest with in-memory fakes rather than live services
suites.notes: Despite the name this needs no Docker. It is the dedicated test for the embedding dimension guard and the cache-key fingerprint.

suites.framework: pydantic-evals datasets executed by pytest; deterministic, no live LLM
suites.notes: Covers tool routing and approval policy. Cheap enough to run on every change touching the agent surface.
Deliberately absent from the validator registry so no selection path can reach it. Env-var gates, not pytest markers; no custom markers are registered anywhere in this repository.

suites.framework: vitest with jsdom and Testing Library
Playwright across Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, and two mobile emulations
suites.notes: Local only. Its webServer is disabled under CI and it needs a running backend, so the CI step could only fail or vacuously pass; see the playwright-not-in-ci exception.
Determinism, idempotence including across processes, schema validity, and one test per kernel rule asserting it fires on the condition it exists to catch.
